bifrost: springboard/ui/src/linalg.rs (vectors, matrices, quaternions), springboard/ui/src/mesh.rs (mesh layout and buffer allocator), springboard/ui/src/shading.rs (lighting and fog), springboard/sdk/src/view/app.rs (frame drawing), springboard/sdk/src/view/animation.rs (frame timing), springboard/sdk/src/widgets.rs (Material blur), springboard/render/src/imgdec.rs (image decode), springboard/src/gpu/ (internal GLES presenter, not app-facing)
summary: GLKit is an OpenGL and OpenGL ES helper layer (GL view, view controller render loop, shader effects, mesh and texture loading, math). Apple marks most of it deprecated on macOS from 10.14, and macOS requires an OpenGL 3.2 Core Profile context. BifrOSt has no app-facing GL view or shader API; its GPU presenter is internal. Pure Rust models now cover the math types, the mesh layout and a CPU lighting and fog model; apps still get no GPU context, drawable or shader supply.

features.apple: GLKView, GLKViewDelegate (init(frame:context:), drawableColorFormat, bindDrawable, display, snapshot); macOS deprecated 10.14
features.bifrost: none app-facing; internal EGL/GLES target in springboard/src/gpu/mod.rs
features.note: apps cannot obtain a GL context or drawable; the presenter draws the desktop only

features.apple: GLKViewController (preferredFramesPerSecond, isPaused, pauseOnWillResignActive, resumeOnDidBecomeActive); iOS and tvOS only per docc, not on macOS
features.bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/view/app.rs:216 draw(), :222 draw_at(ctx, s, t) time-based drawing; springboard/sdk/src/view/animation.rs (Timing, Transaction)
features.note: apps are redrawn by the SDK's timed draw path, with no frame-rate, pause or app-activation controls

features.bifrost: springboard/ui/src/shading.rs (CPU Blinn-Phong lighting, shade()); shader sources in springboard/src/gpu/shaders.rs are internal
features.note: lighting is evaluated per point on the CPU; no app-supplied shaders, no reflection-map or skybox effect, and no GPU effect object

features.apple: GLKEffectProperty, Fog, Light, Texture, Material, Transform
features.bifrost: springboard/ui/src/shading.rs (Light, Material, Rgb, Fog); springboard/ui/src/linalg.rs (Matrix4 transform for the transform property)
features.note: light, material and linear or exponential fog values exist; there is no texture property and no effect object that binds them to a drawable

features.apple: No direct GLKit equivalent; GLKBaseEffect and GLKSkyboxEffect cover shading only
features.bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/widgets.rs:22 Material, :297 material(), :307 visual_effect() (blur plus tint, Reduce Transparency); springboard/render/src/gfx.rs:788 glass panel
features.note: the app-facing material covers the blur-and-tint case that shader effects would otherwise be used for; no custom blur radius or shader

features.apple: GLKTextureLoader, GLKTextureInfo (background loading from image files; GLKTextureInfo deprecated 10.14)
features.bifrost: springboard/render/src/imgdec.rs (PNG and JPEG decode); springboard/src/gpu/texture.rs (GPU texture bookkeeping, internal)
features.note: images decode into CPU surfaces; there is no background GPU texture upload API for apps

features.apple: GLKMesh, GLKMeshBuffer, GLKMeshBufferAllocator, GLKSubmesh (deprecated on macOS 10.14)
features.bifrost: springboard/ui/src/mesh.rs (Mesh, Submesh, MeshBuffer, BufferAllocator, validate, primitive_count)
features.note: the byte-range layout, primitive counts and validation exist as pure models; no vertex descriptor, no GPU buffer upload and no mesh loader from files

features.bifrost: springboard/ui/src/linalg.rs (Vector3, Vector4, Matrix4 with translation, scaling, rotation, perspective, look_at, inverse; Quaternion with slerp and to_matrix4; degrees_to_radians)
features.note: 3D vector, matrix and quaternion values exist in pure Rust; there is no 2D or 3x3 matrix type, no matrix stack and no SDK re-export yet

features.apple: OpenGL 3.2 Core Profile context on macOS, OpenGL ES 2.0 on iOS (per the landing page)
features.note: the GPU stack exists in the system layer, but apps have no context or API to use it

gaps: No app-facing GL view or drawable: apps cannot create an OpenGL or GLES context on BifrOSt (springboard/src/gpu/mod.rs is internal).
No app-supplied shaders and no reflection-map or skybox effects; the CPU lighting model in springboard/ui/src/shading.rs has no GPU binding.
No 3x3 matrix or matrix stack; the 3D math in springboard/ui/src/linalg.rs is not re-exported through the SDK.
No vertex descriptor or GPU buffer upload for springboard/ui/src/mesh.rs, and no mesh loader from model files.
No background GPU texture loader for apps; image decode is CPU-only (springboard/render/src/imgdec.rs).
Apple deprecated most of GLKit on macOS from 10.14. Parity work here would target the Metal-equivalent path rather than GLKit, so this framework may stay a documented n/a for new apps.
